name: evaldiff
description: Evaluation-first regression testing for AI apps: JSONL datasets, graders, baseline diffs, and PR scorecards.

scripts.demo:stability: node bin/evaldiff.js run --cases examples/cases.jsonl --adapter examples/app.mjs --repeat 3 --out .evaldiff/stable-baseline.json && node bin/evaldiff.js run --cases examples/cases.jsonl --adapter examples/unstable-app.mjs --repeat 3 --baseline .evaldiff/stable-baseline.json --out .evaldiff/unstable.json --summary .evaldiff/stability.json --html .evaldiff/stability.html --markdown .evaldiff/stability.md
scripts.demo: node bin/evaldiff.js run --cases examples/cases.jsonl --adapter examples/app.mjs --baseline examples/baseline.json --out .evaldiff/current.json --report .evaldiff/comparison.json --markdown .evaldiff/report.md --html .evaldiff/report.html --summary .evaldiff/summary.json
